UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public and preference profile for an authenticated user of Mr. Hany AI Assistant.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

language.description: Preferred UI and AI response language (ar or en).

memoryRetentionDays.description: Number of days to retain conversation memory.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Individual conversation message stored in a user's persistent history.

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this message.

content.description: Text or markdown content of the message.

skillUsed.description: Name of the AI skill that handled the message.

tokensUsed.description: Total tokens consumed by this message turn.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was recorded.

UserMemory.title: UserMemory
UserMemory.description: User-approved persistent memory fact, preference, or engineering project note.

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this memory item.

category.description: Category of memory (preference, project, engineering, note).

title.description: Concise title of the memory or note.

content.description: Detailed content of the memory or note.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the memory was saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the memory was last updated.

ProcessedFileRecord.title: ProcessedFileRecord
ProcessedFileRecord.description: Metadata record of an analyzed or generated file (DOCX, XLSX, PDF, PPTX, Image, Audio, Video).

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this file record.

fileName.description: Name of the uploaded or generated file.

fileType.description: Category or MIME type of the file.

direction.description: Whether the file was uploaded for analysis or generated by Mr. Hany.

summary.description: Executive summary or key extraction result.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the file was processed.

AdminDoc.title: AdminDoc
AdminDoc.description: Trusted admin registry document keyed by admin UID.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin was registered.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile and preferences without PII exposure.

/messages/{messageId}.description: Stores individual conversation history turns scoped strictly to userId.

/memories/{memoryId}.description: Stores user-approved persistent memories and Keep-compatible notes scoped strictly to userId.

/files/{fileId}.description: Stores metadata and summaries of analyzed and generated files scoped strictly to userId.
